description: Precomputed lookup table for small operands. 8-bit: 64KB table. Hybrid: run binary GCD until operands < 256, then O(1) table lookup.
mathematical_formalization: table[a][b] = gcd(a,b) for a,b in [0,255]. Size = 256*256 = 64KB. Fits in L1 cache.
implementation_hypothesis: When both operands < 256, return table[a][b]. Saves ~8 final iterations. Must verify L1 cache impact.
experiment_seed: Profile iteration count distribution. Measure speedup from LUT early-exit on 64-bit inputs.
